intro: Compare values across categories or stack segments per bucket. BarChart shares the same `data`, `xKey`, and `series` model as other cartesian charts.
useCases: Stacked contributions by team or region.

faqs.question: How do I stack bars?
faqs.answer: Set `stacked` on the chart and assign the same `stackId` on series that should pile together.

faqs.question: Can I tune bar spacing?
faqs.answer: Use Recharts props via composition when you need finer control; defaults favor legible category spacing.

sections.heading: What it does
sections.body:
Draws vertical bars per category with optional stacking.

Axes, grid, and tooltip wiring mirror line and area charts for predictability.

sections.heading: Data shape
sections.body: Rows hold category labels in `xKey` and numeric measures per `series.dataKey`.

sections.heading: Accessibility
sections.body:
Keep category labels short and unique for screen reader context in tooltips.

Prefer sufficient color separation between adjacent series.

sections.heading: Next.js integration notes
sections.body: Import from `@zentauri-ui/zentauri-components/charts/bar` inside client components when interaction is required.
